title: Understanding k-fold Cross-Validation
text: In k-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into k subsets, and the model is trained k times, each time using a different subset as the validation set and the remaining subsets as the training set.

title: Effect of Using Entire Training Set
text: Consider what happens when you use the entire training set for training in each fold. Does this align with the purpose of cross-validation?

title: Purpose of Cross-Validation
text: The purpose of cross-validation is to assess how the results of a statistical analysis will generalize to an independent data set. It helps in detecting overfitting.

title: Analyzing the Modification
text: If you use the entire training set for training in each fold, are you still validating the model's performance on unseen data?
